description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Message interface in Java, providing a data structure to represent messages with headers, payloads, extra data, and response handling in a messaging system within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableMessage
classes.description: An immutable generic class implementing the Message interface, representing an immutable message object with headers, payload, extra data, and optional response consumer.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create an ImmutableMessage instance with specified headers, payload, extra data, and optional response consumer.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the payload if present.

methods.name: getRawPayload
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the cloned raw ByteBuffer payload if present.

methods.name: getExtra
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing extra JSON data if present.

methods.name: getResponseConsumer
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the response consumer if present.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the message from headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with the message.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject string of the message.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the optional timestamp of the message.

methods.name: getStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the optional HTTP status code.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare message instances based on rawPayload, payload, extra, and headers.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode based on rawPayload, payload, extra, and headers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the message object.
